title: Q-MMR: Off-Policy Evaluation via Recursive Reweighting and Moment Matching
abstract: arXiv:2605.06474v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a novel theoretical framework, Q-MMR, for off-policy evaluation in finite-horizon MDPs. Q-MMR learns a set of scalar weights, one for each data point, such that the reweighted rewards approximate the expected return under the target policy. The weights are learned inductively in a top-down manner via a moment matching objective against a value-function discriminator class. Notably, and perhaps surprisingly, a data-dependent finite-sample guarantee for general function approximation can be established under only the realizability of $Q^\pi$, with a dimension-free bound -- that is, the error does not depend on the statistical complexity of the function class. We also establish connections to several existing methods, such as importance sampling and linear FQE. Further theoretical analyses shed new light on the nature of coverage, a concept of fundamental importance to offline RL.

translated_title: Q-MMR：通过递归重加权与矩匹配进行离策略评估
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的理论框架 Q-MMR，用于有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的离策略评估。Q-MMR 学习一组标量权重，每个数据点对应一个权重，使得重加权后的奖励能够近似目标策略下的期望回报。这些权重通过与价值函数判别器类进行矩匹配的目标，以自上而下的方式归纳地学习。值得注意的是，或许令人惊讶的是，在仅需 $Q^\pi$ 可实现性的条件下，即可为一般函数逼近建立数据相关的有限样本保证，且该边界与维度无关——也就是说，误差不依赖于函数类的统计复杂度。我们还与若干现有方法建立了联系，例如重要性采样和线性 FQE。进一步的理论分析为覆盖性这一离线强化学习中至关重要的概念的本质提供了新的认识。
tldr: 提出 Q-MMR 框架，通过自上而下的递归重加权和矩匹配学习每个数据点的权重来实现离策略评估，并在仅假设 Q 函数可实现性的条件下获得与维度无关的有限样本保证。
en_tdlr: Q-MMR learns per-data-point scalar weights via top-down recursive reweighting and moment matching for off-policy evaluation, achieving dimension-free finite-sample guarantees under only the realizability of the Q-function.
